query:
UPDATE label_templates
           SET name = $3, purpose = $4, size_preset = $5, width_tenths_mm = $6,
               height_tenths_mm = $7, dpi = $8, barcode_token = $9, include_qr = $10,
               fields = $11, is_default = $12, active = $13, updated_at = now()
           WHERE org_id = $1 AND id = $2
